newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Q2 wood and paper output falls again.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Q2 wood and paper output falls again.

text.p: Finnish wood and paper output fell in the second quarter to post the third consecutive quarterly loss, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
Gross domestic product (GDP) in Q2 rose 1.6 percent year-on-year after a 1.4-percent increase in Q1, putting first half GDP growth at 1.5 percent, it said.
"Wood and paper pruduction fell for the third consequtive quarter and was almost nine percent smaller than in the second quarter last year," SF said.
Second-quarter production also slipped in the forestry and the restaurant and hotel sectors, it said.
"Metal industry production rose five percent. Energy and water supply rose almost eight percent," it said.
Earnings increased 4.7 percent, but private consumption rose "only 1.5 percent", SF said.
"Consumers were particularly interested in durable goods such as cars, electrical appliances and white goods," it said.
Investment in machines and equipment increased more than 14 percent, but investment in construction fell further by some four percent in the second quarter, it said.
